name: RIPEMD
description: Browser-based RIPEMD hash calculator supporting RIPEMD, RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-160, RIPEMD-256, and RIPEMD-320. All computation is local — no data is transmitted.
headline: RIPEMD-160 Hash Calculator
featureList: Text hashing, File hashing, Hex output, Base64 output, Binary output, Hash history, Random hash generation
